integrity: All 32 five-query witness patterns are reproduced by a standalone Python 3 checker; the infinite upper bound is a mathematical proof and not based on finite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for Boolean Hamming radius exactly two, on full binary cubes, with sharp classification for dimensions at least seven. It is not a classification of other radii, nonbinary alphabets or induced subgraphs. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact five-dimensional static and online shattering of binary Hamming two-spheres
